environment.description: Same Lambda@Edge function deployed on CloudFront distribution with restricted viewer access. Distribution configured with a trusted key group (key-group-id: kg-29f8a1c3) using RSA-2048 key pair for URL signing. Default cache behavior requires signed URLs (TrustedKeyGroups set). Additionally, the S3 bucket has a resource policy that only allows GetObject when aws:Referer matches an internal token AND the request originates from the specific CloudFront distribution's OAI. CloudFront also has a custom origin request policy that strips and re-encodes URI components using percent-encoding normalization (Origin Request Policy ID: 88a5eaf4-2fd4-4709-b370-b4c650ea3fcf with 'URI path normalization' enabled in the distribution's edge configuration, which resolves Unicode escape sequences to their percent-encoded byte representations before the Lambda@Edge trigger fires).

config.notes: Signed URL policy restricts to specific path prefix matching /files/{username}/* pattern. Key pair rotation every 72h via Secrets Manager.
